an6.105:1.1: Tayo 'me bhikkhave bhavā pahātabbā, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṃ. Katame tayo bhavā pahātabbā? Kāmabhavo, rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo. Ime tayo bhavā pahātabbā. Katamāsu tīsu sikkhitabbam? Adhisīlasikkhāya, adhicittasikkhāya, adhipaññāsikkhāya. Imāsu tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṃ. Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ime tayo bhavā pahīnā honti, imāsu ca tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitasikkho hoti: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu acchejji taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassā ti.
